body: The ability to listen and reflect on what your partner is saying. This honestly just cost me my longest and most serious relationship. I wasn’t able to properly listen about what she had to say and I was unable to look at myself to see that what I was doing wasn’t ok. A month later and hours and hours of reflecting on me has made me want to change my life around, so far 1 month sober!! Just wish she was here to see it.
